The blocks are organized into rows, each row featuring a distinct color: white, pink, yellow, green, purple, blue, orange, and red. These blocks appear to be part of a game or puzzle set, designed for creative play or problem-solving activities. caption: The video showcases a white tabletop holding parallel rows of 3D-printed U-shaped holders in rainbow colors—magenta, red, orange, gold, yellow, light green, dark green, teal, purple, blue—each seating a white domino, with extra lines of plain white dominoes along the front-left and back-right edges. The magenta, red and orange holders already hold tilted or flat pieces in the opening frame, while most others stand upright. Under a fixed camera the staggered toppling continues across the scene. The gold piece tips early, then the yellow piece follows. The plain white line at the front-left edge collapses from its right end, each piece knocking the next until most lie flat. The light green holder's piece then tips and settles horizontal, followed by the dark green piece, which leans and drops the same way. Toward the close of the clip the teal holder's piece is seen tilting as well. The purple and blue pieces remain standing, and the toppling sequence is still continuing as the clip ends.
